set.statement: Each poll, the daemon picks, in each project, the accepted change sets that rhiza ready says can start, that serve a milestone intent or, as daemon-picks-backlog sets out by the repo's [schedule] backlog rule, serve none, have at least one leaf, have no live run (running or interrupted, as run-one-live counts it) and whose latest run is not a failed run still in the inbox (as inbox-list keeps it: not abandoned, not retried, no newer run), in that project's roadmap milestone order (with the backlog placed and ordered as daemon-picks-backlog sets out, not by the roadmap's backlog group), and starts them, round-robin across projects as root-daemon-round-robin sets out, until its running runs (live runs whose process is running) reach the machine-wide maxRuns (default 2), so an interrupted run keeps its change set from being picked but takes no slot and a failed run's change set is never started again by the daemon until the owner clears that item; it never picks a draft, proposed or leafless change set on its own. Runs the owner queued (run-start-through-daemon) are not picks: they skip these filters and only share the maxRuns slots.
